nodes.label: All-in cash-account simulation and exit comparison
nodes.rationale: Implements all-affordable cash sizing and removes the $100 account-drawdown control. Ten registered executions compare three exits across nominal, doubled-cost and doubled-delay fixtures on the same FTFT entry; protective exits reduce loss without establishing profitability.

nodes.label: All-affordable settled-cash sizing
nodes.rationale: Requested quantity is floor(available_settled_cash / (entry_cap + entry_fee_per_share)). The old planning cap and financial sizing ceilings are removed, while future quote capacity, IOC cancellation, one filled episode per date and settlement remain. The nominal 199-share entry spent $985.448; larger exits encountered later, worse-priced capacity, so losses do not scale linearly from fifty shares.

nodes.label: fixed_15m exit policy
nodes.rationale: Retains the 1.5-ATR initial stop, 2R target and fifteen-minute deadline. The nominal 199-share trade lost $76.906 as capacity-limited liquidation sold successive shares below the stop trigger.

nodes.label: breakeven_1atr exit policy
nodes.rationale: After one ATR of net marked gain, raises the stop to cost-aware breakeven rounded upward. The nominal stop became $4.96, but delayed, partial execution below that trigger still lost $5.006.

nodes.label: trail_1atr exit policy
nodes.rationale: After one ATR of net marked gain, raises the stop monotonically to the greater of breakeven and highest observed bid minus one frozen ATR. Its higher final stop triggered slightly earlier, but routing reached the same executable quotes as breakeven, producing the same $5.006 nominal loss.
